subject: issue when wanting to use older version on Shiny(10.1) instead of newer (10.2)

messages.author: c3eccd174bef82fb
messages.subject: issue when wanting to use older version on Shiny(10.1) instead of newer (10.2)
parts:
Hi,

I have built an application using Shiny 10.1 - not the latest version. When I run the app locally, it runs smoothly without any issue, but when I use deployApp() to put it on shinyapps, the application fails to load. There is no error in the whole process of deploying it to shinyapps, but the screen on deployed app on shinyapps quickly times out showing only the header. This behavior is similar to when I tried using Shiny 10.2(latest) locally.

Here is the link: https://sarang.shinyapps.io/vanmap/

So, one or more of the following could have happened: 
1. The code is not right and that's why it breaks in shinyapps. -- doesn't look likely because faulty code would break in local runs too.
2. The application times out owing to connection to an external data source.-- How to prevent timeout when the program is connecting to data sources on the net?
3. Shinyapps has installed latest package of Shiny, instead of older version used locally -- What can I do to make shinyapps use a specific version of a package rather than the latest?

I checked logs, but could not find anything there. Maybe there is another possibility I am not considering.

Your help is highly appreciated. Thank you in advance.

Cheers,
-SB

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: issue when wanting to use older version on Shiny(10.1) instead of newer (10.2)
parts:
Hi Andy,

Finally, it worked!

The logs on website did not show the error and I have no Javascript knowledge, so i went to 'Inspect Element' on the app page and found out that the 'leaflet-heatmap.js' had an issue with SSL (it was calling 'http://' instead of 'https://' and so Google Chrome chose to not run the Javascript. To overcome the issue, I changed two things:
1. Downloaded the JS file from internet to a separate 'www' folder within the folder where my ui.R and server.R resided. I used direct reference to JS file in my R code instead of the web reference.
2. The map file was also using non-SSL reference for the map TileLayer. I was using Stamen TonerLite. I googled the SSL version of the same link and pasted it in my code.

This has solved the issues for both, the map PNG file and heatmap JS file. 
I hope this helps other people doing similar kind of stuff on Shinyapps. If there is a better way, I would be interested to know.

Cheers!
-Sarang

On Tuesday, December 9, 2014 3:16:04 AM UTC-5, Sarang Brahme wrote:

Hi,

I have built an application using Shiny 10.1 - not the latest version. When I run the app locally, it runs smoothly without any issue, but when I use deployApp() to put it on shinyapps, the application fails to load. There is no error in the whole process of deploying it to shinyapps, but the screen on deployed app on shinyapps quickly times out showing only the header. This behavior is similar to when I tried using Shiny 10.2(latest) locally.

Here is the link: https://sarang.shinyapps.io/vanmap/

So, one or more of the following could have happened: 
1. The code is not right and that's why it breaks in shinyapps. -- doesn't look likely because faulty code would break in local runs too.
2. The application times out owing to connection to an external data source.-- How to prevent timeout when the program is connecting to data sources on the net?
3. Shinyapps has installed latest package of Shiny, instead of older version used locally -- What can I do to make shinyapps use a specific version of a package rather than the latest?

I checked logs, but could not find anything there. Maybe there is another possibility I am not considering.

Your help is highly appreciated. Thank you in advance.

Cheers,
-SB
